notes.title: Content Update: EA 1.5! Keybinds, gameplay tweaks
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I am putting out the most recent update! I've been working on some re-tooling in order to make more scenarios, but in the meantime I have added some customization options and other features:

[h2]Customization options:[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now change they keybinds for all of the actions.
[*] In addition to the biome selector, you can change things like map size and terrain height.
[/list]


[h2]Gameplay updates:[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new Fern plant type has been added! Ferns only grow in the shade and will die if left in the sun for too long. 
[*] I have reworked how seeds and roots work. As plants level up, you can increase the number of roots they have (click on them to see the menu). More roots keep the plants from drying out, but will also compete for water with other plants!
[*] Seeds are more expensive to place, but you can now spawn them cheaply from an existing plant. (Use the wind to your advantage!)
[*] I have added a Walking camera (default "J" key) where you can walk around with your furry or feathered friends. Press "J" again to go back to the normal camera.
[/list]

Have fun in your little empire, and thanks to all of those who have left reviews!

notes.title: Custom Maps Update!
notes.content:
I'm pleased to provide a small update that allows you to include your own custom heightmaps! You can now import a jpg/jpeg file to use in your games.

I'm continuing to work on some new features that will fill out the game progression.

notes.title: Minor update for February - Bears!
notes.content:
I hope everyone is having a relaxing time in Woodland Empire. After a break, I'm back at some regular updates that will be coming in the next few weeks as I work down the development roadmap. 

This update includes bears, which are a another top-tier predator. Let me know what you think and leave a review!

Nick

notes.title: Progress update - Additional time controls
notes.content:
Hi Woodlanders!

I have a small update that allows you to control the speed of the seasons as well as the speed of the day/night cycle.

[list]
[*] Increasing the season speed will also increase the maturity rate of plants in your forest.
[*] Increasing the day/night cycle will provide better sunlight to undergrowth plants
[/list]

Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1419150/discussions/0/5965578747690984263/]Early Access Roadmap[/url] in the forums to see a full list of upcoming changes:


Happy foresting!

notes.title: Putting out fires
notes.content:
The latest build should provide some much needed stability for both Windows and Linux users. 

I had to re-engineer some of how the simulation happens, so it's not all optimized yet but hopefully you should not see any more in-game crashes!

Some of the minor things are:

[list]
[*] A new 4th tutorial about the cycle of life
[*] An expensive new tornado that kills trees level 3 and above (Rips 'em right out)
[*] A new fire simulation that should only burn down your forest - not your computer.
[*] The sunlight simulation draft is in - Plants grow faster when they have direct sunlight
[/list]


What's still coming up:
[list]
[*] I need to re-visit some performance stuff that was re-engineered with the old, crashing code
[*] I'll be re-balancing some of the fire attributes to better simulate brush fires that would leave older, larger trees standing just fine.
[*] Getting to work on more plant and animal species
[/list]

notes.title: New Tutorials
notes.content:
A couple of starter tutorials are now available, with more to come.

There are also a couple of new maps to try out.

After a couple of weeks of overhauling the save-game system and some reorganization of the main menus.

Other new things in this update:
[list]
[*]Redwood/Sequoia trees are now available
[*]Rain clouds are now limited by the amount of water evaporated from the surface and transpired from trees
[*]Rain will now auto-spawn when humidity reaches a high enough level.
[*]You can now manually place fertilizer zones, though they cost a great deal of harmony.
[*]Herbivore birds should be better at flocking now.
[*]Some buggy issues with ground animal movement have been fixed.
[*]The main menu has been updated to accommodate future scenario maps.
[/list]


If you have previously saved games, you will need to convert them using the "Convert old saves" button. This should only need to be done once.


If you have more improvement suggestions, go ahead and let me know on discord:
https://discord.gg/edfPFnzd7P

notes.title: Updated Gameplay elements
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Based on recent gameplay feedback, I've updated a few resource costs and simplified some mechanics: 

[list]
[*] New games start with significantly more trees and grass, allowing you to jump into better gameplay more quickly.
[*] Seeds spawn automatically, but at a reduced rate
[*] All plant upgrades come with automatic root upgrades.
[*] Ground animals now are able to sleep
[*] Most animals are more likely to reproduce, allowing animal creation without spending currency.
[*] All animals can die of old age, but are cheaper to place. This should encourage the hunting and placing mechanics
[*] New Fire models to increase graphics performance. It should be more clear which plants are currently engulfed in flames.
[/list]


Coming next are some better tutorials and more achievements.

If you have more improvement suggestions, go ahead and let me know on discord: 
https://discord.gg/edfPFnzd7P
